title: Parameterized chair
public_brief: Create a chair with four legs; seat 0.45 m high; preserve width during seat-height edit
proposed_acceptance_checks: Counts; dimensions; contacts; local edit preserves protected parts

title: Stylized organic creature
public_brief: Create an asymmetric stylized creature with explicit limb and appendage counts
proposed_acceptance_checks: Required parts; multiview silhouette; part separation; identity after targeted edit

title: Measured room placement
public_brief: Place furniture in a 4 m by 3 m room with an unobstructed required passage
proposed_acceptance_checks: World-space dimensions; passage clearance; contacts; object counts
injected_defect_for_phase_2: One required object placed outside room

title: Modular corridor
public_brief: Build repeated door variants; dress visible rooms; use organized asset collections
proposed_acceptance_checks: Required variants/counts; containment; camera path clearance; collection structure
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Overlapping door or obstructed camera path

title: Material-only edit
public_brief: Change a known object material to the supplied target; preserve geometry and transforms
proposed_acceptance_checks: Matched-camera render comparison; numeric geometry/transform invariants
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Lighting changed to disguise incorrect material

title: Lighting reconstruction
public_brief: Match target shadow and lighting on a fixed scene and fixed camera
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Incorrect light compensated by camera shift

title: Mesh health repair
public_brief: Repair a supplied defective solid without changing its intended silhouette
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Degenerate face hidden behind visible surface

title: Contact and hidden-side repair
public_brief: Attach a handle at specified contact points without altering the body
proposed_acceptance_checks: Measured contact/clearance; rear and side evidence; protected body
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Handle moved closer but still disconnected

title: Hinged articulated lamp
public_brief: Model a lamp with defined hinge pivots and bounded rigid movement
proposed_acceptance_checks: Pivot positions; travel limits; collision/clearance at test poses
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Pivot offset masked in neutral pose

title: Existing character sitting
public_brief: Pose a supplied known rig into a seated position; preserve identity and rig
proposed_acceptance_checks: Pose-specific deformation review; rig invariants; contact; held-out frames
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Bone rotation with mesh deformation failure

title: UV and prop export
public_brief: Prepare a supplied prop for the specified texture and export format
proposed_acceptance_checks: Task-specific UV checks; texture presence; reopen and export round-trip

title: Environment export and local revision
public_brief: Export only intended assets then revise one prop while preserving the remaining scene
proposed_acceptance_checks: Export bounds/contents; clean reopen; protected object state comparisons
injected_defect_for_phase_2: Oversized studio floor included in export
